newsitem.title: USA: Individual Investor sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Individual Investor sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Individual Investor Group Inc said on Tuesday that it expects to report a greater than anticipated loss for the third quarter, because of increased expenses in expanding its business.
The financial publisher said it anticipates record revenues for the period, fueled by increases in advertising pages and rates per page, Individual Investor said.
In last year's third quarter, the company reported a profit of $0.09 a share, or $505,000, on revenues of $2.05 million.
Individual Investor said it is pleased with the expansion of the business and that expenses in the quarter have yet to be offset by revenues to be realized in future quarters.
